prompt: A frame from a feature film set in the 1920s, shot on grainy 35mm colour film, the picture filling the frame edge to edge. The people come from the references; the setting, light and style come only from this description. Every moving thing leaves three or four fading afterimages split into pure red, green and blue, like a long exposure lit by coloured flashes; everything still stays sharp. Camera at the kerb, low and tilted. On a bandstand at night, the man from the character reference, dressed exactly as in his portrait reference, throws up his arms in a magician's pose as a magnesium flash pops white in a cloud of smoke and the crowd turns to look; behind the smoke a getaway car screeches away from the bank steps, money sacks in its back windows, a police car swinging round after it. Strings of bulbs; wet cobbles streaked with every light. Thanks.
